title: Aburi Plugin Manifest
description: Plugin manifest declaring extension vocabulary contributed to Aburi. A manifest file is validated against this schema by @aburi/plugin-registry's loadPluginManifest / parsePluginManifest. At plugin load time the CLI does not apply the schema: it hands the plugin's manifest object to the registry, which checks the types of name, version and provides, reserved and per-type namespaces, xPrefix, languageId, grammarRevision and conflicts with the manifests already registered.

$schema.description: The first value is this schema's $id, the one to write. The second is the host the schema was served from before aburi.dev; documents that name it remain valid.

xPrefix.description: (type=effects only) Identifier used as the x-<xPrefix> prefix for owned effect ids. Defaults to <name> with leading 'effects-' stripped. Example: name='effects-prisma' → xPrefix='prisma' → owned ids: 'x-prisma:*'.

languageId.description: (type=lang only) The <language> token every Symbol id this plugin mints opens with (e.g., 'ts' for 'ts:src/a.ts#f'). No two loaded plugins may declare the same one, and 'slice' is reserved. The registry requires it of a type=lang manifest; the schema leaves it optional so that lang manifests written before the field remain valid v1 documents.

grammarRevision.description: (type=lang only) The exact grammar the plugin parses with, as '<grammar-package>@<MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH>' (e.g., 'tree-sitter-typescript@0.23.2'). The scan records it in the IR's generator.plugins[].grammarRevision, so that two IRs say whether their syntax fingerprints were computed over one grammar. A lang manifest that declares none is recorded as '<name>@<version>' without build metadata, its manifest's version standing for its grammar: that holds only while the version changes with every grammar change.

aburi.description: Semver range of compatible Aburi core.

capabilities.description: Optional runtime capabilities the plugin advertises. Source-of-truth for CLI concurrency budgets.

allOf.description: type=effects: only x-* effects/effectPrefixes allowed; no framework:*/fp:*/oop:*/meta:* extKinds. languageId, grammarRevision and wasmHeapPerWorkerMB are lang-only and must be absent.
type=framework: only framework:* extKinds; no x-* effects. languageId, grammarRevision and wasmHeapPerWorkerMB are lang-only and must be absent.
type=lang: only fp:*/oop:*/meta:* extKinds; no x-* effects, no frameworks.

effectPrefixes.description: Plugin-owned x-<ns> prefixes. The plugin may emit any x-<ns>:<action> under these at extraction time without enumerating each id.

extKindPrefixes.description: Plugin-owned extKind prefixes. Minimum 2 segments (e.g., 'framework:nestjs', not just 'framework'). The plugin may emit <prefix>:<extra> at extraction time without enumerating each id.

exitCalls.description: Functions a module exports that never return to their caller: each throws, or ends the process, on every call. A call to one, read through the import that binds it, leaves the flow as a throw does, so an if whose consequence makes one is a guard. Optional; absent declares none.

module.description: The module specifier an import names, e.g. next/navigation.

exports.description: The names the module exports them under; default for its default export.

wasmHeapPerWorkerMB.description: (type=lang only) Expected WASM heap usage per parser worker in MiB; 256 when absent. The CLI divides the free memory by the largest value among the loaded language plugins and caps the parser worker count, a requested --concurrency included, at the result, never below one worker.

baseKind.description: Nearest core SymbolKind that consumers without this extension can fall back to.
